### 0.1.494
- [#210](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/210) — #209 Added: per-PR summaries and native startup release notes — build +6
  <p>LeonardoMD shows the changes included in each new version at startup. You can hide the notice for that version or reopen it from the application menu.</p>
- [#213](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/213) — #208 Added: resize preview tables with persisted MDLF geometry — build +9
  <p>Resize columns, rows and whole tables in Preview with the mouse or keyboard. Markdown documents migrate safely to MDLF to preserve table dimensions.</p>
- [#221](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/221) — #220 Fixed: improve light-theme document indicator contrast — build +3
  <p>Improve document format and storage indicator contrast in light themes using the palette heading color.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.1.494)

<!-- release-ledger:event:v1: -->
### 0.1.571
- [#229](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/229) — #228 Added: file list colors filtering and sorting — build +4
  <p>Distinguish Leonardo files in wine, configure file colors globally or per project, and filter and sort the project file list.</p>
- [#231](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/231) — #230 Added: document undo and redo history — build +4
  <p>Undo and redo document edits from the toolbar or keyboard, with separate history for each document and support for source, preview and form editing.</p>
- [#235](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/235) — #234 Fixed: preserve form presentation in Preview and Split — build +5
  <p>Preview and Split preserve the field presentation shown in Fill form.</p>
- [#237](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/237) — #236 Added: promote an exact beta without changing its version — build +2
  <p>Promote a chosen validated beta to stable while preserving its version and exact signed artifact, even when newer betas exist.</p>
- [#233](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/233) — #232 Fixed: enlarge form calendars and follow document themes — build +12
  <p>Form date fields offer a larger calendar in the active theme, with localized labels, keyboard navigation and a safe fallback for malformed locales, while preserving editable drafts.</p>
- [#217](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/217) — #216 Added: export Leonardo reading copies as Markdown — build +14
  <p>Export Leonardo documents and form answers as Markdown with a loss warning and portable image handling.</p>
- [#242](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/242) — #241 Fixed: move user deletions to Trash — build +12
  <p>Deleted files, folders and projects now move to Trash so they can be recovered.</p>
- [#250](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/250) — #249 Refactored: retire proprietary mobile Git — build +11
  <p>Little Leonardo becomes read-only, preserves older work against cache overwrites and exports it for recovery; proprietary Git is retired while desktop synchronization and system Git remain available.</p>
- [#248](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/pull/248) — #247 Fixed: attach auxiliary windows and document dialogs as modal sheets — build +13
  <p>About, Release notes, confirmations and file selection attach as modal sheets; file actions reject changes to the active project or workspace.</p>
- Accepted evidence: [verified event](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/releases/tag/v0.1.571)
